div.head: II Cn 58
div.ab: Gif hwa ciningces borh abrece, gebete þæt mid V pundan.
Gif hwa cyninges borh abrece, gebe[te] þæt mid fif pundum.
Si quis plegium (pacem) regis frangat, emendet V libras.
Be borhbryce. Gif hwa kynincges borh abrece, gebete þæt mid V pundum.
Gif hwa ciningces borh abrece, gebete þæt mid V pundan.
Concerning the violation of protection. If anyone violates the king's protection, he shall pay £5 as compensation.
If anyone violates the king’s protection, he shall be penalized five pounds.
If anyone violates the king’s surety, he is to compensate for it with five pounds.
(Vom Bruch der Schutzgewähr. B) Wenn einer des Königs Schutzgewähr verletzt, büsse er das mit 5 Pfund [dem Könige].
(Of the breach of protection. B) If anyone violates the king's protection, let him atone for it with 5 pounds [to the king].

note.label: paraphrases
note.quote: When Alfred's domboc was quoted ... Alfred's law was not so much quoted as paraphrased (n. 421: II Cn 58 – 58:2, Af 3)

note.label: equivalent
note.quote: As regards II Cn 58 – 58:2 above, note that the form of the equivalent law in Grið 11 is in some ways closer to Alfred's original
